package.description: The DMT Normalization Module provides additional functionality to LabChart when performing in vitro experiments on isolated vessels with Danish Myo Technology wire myographs.

en-US.description: The DMT Normalization Module provides additional functionality to LabChart when performing in vitro experiments on isolated vessels with Danish Myo Technology wire myographs.
en-US.longDescription: The DMT Normalization Module provides additional functionality to LabChart when performing in vitro experiments on isolated vessels with Danish Myo Technology wire myographs. Calculating the normalized internal circumference, and from this the micrometer setting at which a vessel will have suitable initial wall tension.
en-US.name: ADInstruments DMT Normalization

zh-CN.description: DMT Normalization 模块为 LabChart 提供了额外功能，专用于使用丹麦肌电技术(Danish Myo Technology)线式肌动描记器对离体血管进行体外实验时使用。
zh-CN.longDescription: DMT Normalization 模块为 LabChart 提供了额外功能，用于在使用丹麦 Myo Technology 丝线肌动图系统进行离体血管实验时，计算标准化血管内周长，并据此确定血管达到适宜初始壁张力所需的微米计设置。

package.longDescription: The DMT Normalization Module provides additional functionality to LabChart when performing in vitro experiments on isolated vessels with Danish Myo Technology wire myographs. Calculating the normalized internal circumference, and from this the micrometer setting at which a vessel will have suitable initial wall tension.
package.name: ADInstruments DMT Normalization
